![The Newer Than Adventure Logo. The text "NEWER" is in large, bold, golden letters and underneath in a smaller, thinner, more grey font is the text "THAN ADVENTURE".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed77d578be0f41ff19f89248f3fef3f6cc2dfea5.png)

---
## Newer Than Adventure!
**This is a texture pack for Better Than Adventure inspired by Jappa's texture art.**

All of the blocks and items NOT added by the mod have had their newest textures backported. Any new blocks or items have custom Jappa-inspired textures to match.

## What you should expect:
This pack is less of a literal translation of textures and more of a flexible reimagining of the base mod. A fair few textures use Jappa art as a base, but I plan to change and tweak a lot of the textures in the future to more closely match the intent of the original textures. This also means that if I think there's a texture that might benefit from having a different look from the original, I'm gonna try it out.

### If you download this pack and give it a try, I hope you enjoy!
